subject.title: fix(nostr): keep profile imports as cancellable drafts

question: Should the Control UI intentionally change Nostr imports from immediate persisted merges to cancellable drafts that require Save & Publish, while retaining explicit `autoMerge: true` for other HTTP callers?
rationale: The implementation and proof support the safer behavior, but automated review cannot decide whether existing users may rely on the Control UI's current one-click persistence timing.

options.title: Approve Draft-Only UI Imports
options.body: Accept the safer Control UI workflow in which imported relay values remain reviewable and cancellable until Save & Publish, while preserving the explicit HTTP persistence contract.

options.title: Retain Immediate UI Persistence
options.body: Do not merge this behavior unless the UI keeps or separately exposes the existing import-and-persist workflow for users who rely on it.

recommendation.title: Approve Draft-Only UI Imports
recommendation.body: Accept the safer Control UI workflow in which imported relay values remain reviewable and cancellable until Save & Publish, while preserving the explicit HTTP persistence contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The feature and most subsequent Nostr HTTP contract work trace to this contributor's merged history.
